name: Ultimate AI Game Developer on: issues: types: [opened, edited] permissions: contents: write pull-requests: write issues: write jobs: auto-code-generator: runs-on: ubuntu-latest timeout-minutes: 30 steps: - name: 1. Checkout Repository uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: 2. Set up Python Environment uses: actions/setup-python@v5 with: python-version: '3.10' - name: 3. Install Requirements run: pip install requests - name: 4. Create and Execute AI Brain env: GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }} ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }} ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }} run: | cat << 'EOF' > ai_brain.py import os import json import requests import sys import re import time def main(): api_key = os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY") if not api_key: print("❌ Error: GEMINI_API_KEY is missing!") sys.exit(1) issue_title = os.environ.get("ISSUE_TITLE", "No Title") issue_body = os.environ.get("ISSUE_BODY", "No Body") # ✅ ফিক্স: নতুন ফাইল omega-racer.html তৈরি করবে file_path = "omega-racer.html" current_code = "" if os.path.exists(file_path): with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f: current_code = f.read() else: print(f"📁 {file_path} not found. AI will create a brand new OMEGA file!") # 🚀 PROMPT (High Graphics Focus) prompt = f"""You are an elite, senior WebGL/Canvas game developer. Based on the GitHub issue below, write a high-graphics, extremely smooth (60 FPS) browser game. Issue Title: {issue_title} Issue Description: {issue_body} Current Code (if any): {current_code} STRICT RULES: 1. Build the ultimate racing game using advanced HTML5 Canvas or CSS3 3D transforms. 2. DO NOT use external assets (No external images/sounds). Generate visuals using Canvas drawing API or CSS shapes. 3. Return ONLY valid, highly optimized HTML/CSS/JS code. No explanations. 4. DO NOT include markdown formatting like ```html. Just raw code starting with . 5. Ensure it is fully responsive and has mobile touch controls. """ model_name = "gemini-1.5-flash-latest" url = f"[https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/](https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/){model_name}:generateContent?key={api_key}" headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"} payload = { "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt}]}], "generationConfig": { "temperature": 0.3, "maxOutputTokens": 8192 } } max_retries = 3 for attempt in range(1, max_retries + 1): print(f"⏳ Attempt {attempt}/{max_retries}: Generating High-Graphics Game... Please wait.") try: response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=1200) response.raise_for_status() data = response.json() new_code = data["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"] # 🧹 CLEANUP MARKDOWN BUGS new_code = re.sub(r'^```(html|javascript|css)?\s*', '', new_code, flags=re.IGNORECASE) new_code = re.sub(r'```$', '', new_code.strip()) with open(file_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(new_code) print("✅ AI successfully generated the OMEGA file!") sys.exit(0) except Exception as e: print(f"❌ Attempt {attempt} Failed: {e}") if attempt < max_retries: time.sleep(10) else: sys.exit(1) if __name__ == "__main__": main() EOF python ai_brain.py - name: 5. Create Pull Request uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6 with: commit-message: "feat: Created Omega Racer via Gemini AI" title: "🚀 Omega Game Update: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}" body: "This update introduces the brand new `omega-racer.html` file! 🎮" branch: "omega-update-${{ github.event.issue.number }}" delete-branch: true
